title: Use ReadCommitted isolation for CalcFields in Job Queue Entry GetXmlContent
summary: Job Queue Entry GetXmlContent method now uses ReadCommitted isolation when reading the XML parameter BLOB to prevent unnecessary locking and blocking in concurrent scenarios.
key_points: Adds explicit ReadIsolation(IsolationLevel::ReadCommitted) to CalcFields(XML) call in GetXmlContent
Prevents locking on job queue entry records during XML parameter reads
Removes implicit isolation escalation when caller is in an updating transaction
No signature or behavior changes to the procedure or related events
Low risk change with same effective isolation as default read behavior
